GM only. This compendium is hidden from players.

The Fenari Were Made

No one knows where the Fenari came from, not even the Fenari. The truth is that they were created: the result of failed experiments on Humans by an unknown man, generations ago. The experiments left their subjects with the half-beast features every Fenari still carries.

This was the original Fenari story, from the 4th Edition campaign where the party only learned it at the end of a mega dungeon built around the Fenari. Nobody in the world knows it, and it should stay that way until your players dig it up.

Threads to Pull

These are open questions, left for you to answer when you build that dungeon:

  • Who was he? A wizard, an alchemist, a cult leader, something that only looked like a man?
  • What was he trying to make? The Fenari's strangest trait, taking on the traits of whoever they live among, might be the experiment's real goal, or its accident.
  • Is he gone? Experiments like his rarely end tidily.
  • Where did it happen? The laboratory, buried and forgotten, is the heart of the dungeon. Fenari caravans may have been circling it for generations without knowing why.
  • What would the Fenari do if they found out? The Creed says to take none in return for harm done to kith and kin. Does that apply to their maker?
